episodes.synopsis: A show off girl named Aya ends up losing her panties somewhere and tries to steal panties from her classmate Konatsu before she's discovered.
episodes.title: Who's Got No Panties!?

episodes.synopsis: Aya develops hiccups, so the others try to help cure them.
episodes.title: The Hiccups Won't Stop

episodes.synopsis: Aya is fearful of her older sister, Saya, and her gang leader boss, Kaname Oku.
episodes.title: Executioner Girl & Demon King's Advent

episodes.synopsis: As Aya's secret underwater plans are thwarted by Asuka Utsunomiya, she almost drowns and ends up having her first kiss taken by Kaname via CPR.
episodes.title: First Kiss at the Pool!?

episodes.synopsis: When Aya gets sick with a cold, Asuka comes over to nurse her back to health in her own unique way.
episodes.title: Utsonomiya's Cold Treatment

episodes.synopsis: Aya comes up with a crazy scheme to try to get Asuka to smile.
episodes.title: Utsunomiya is Mysterious!!

episodes.synopsis: Konatsu gets a lot of Matsuzaka beef, prompting Aya to have a yakiniku party which gets a few uninvited guests.
episodes.title: Gokurakuin Girls' School Carnival

episodes.synopsis: A rich brat named Minami Kurihashi enrols into the high school, inadvertently picking a fight with Aya after cleaning up her hang out spot.
episodes.title: The Princess Descends!!

episodes.synopsis: Aya contracts amnesia after slipping on a banana skin, so the gang work together to try and bring back her memories.
episodes.title: Forgetful Aya-chan

episodes.synopsis: Aya misunderstands a conversation between Konatsu and Ai and gets into a heated debate with Minami about who's more 'appealing'.
episodes.title: Wet Bitch Showdown!!

episodes.synopsis: The girls attend a masquerade ball where everyone besides Ai ends up under the influence of the 'juice' being served.
episodes.title: Crazy Masquerade?

episodes.synopsis: Minami is due to return to LA, so the girls set off some fireworks to see her off.
episodes.title: Farewell, Kurihashi!!
